```{r load-and-score, include = FALSE}
# ---- Participant IDs (same approach as the 07 report) ----
# The survey file may carry response_id and/or prolific_id but no pid. Each file gets all three IDs,
# matched in memory from the pid-to-Prolific link file and the 00 renamed file. Nothing with IDs is written out.
ID_COLS <- c("pid", "response_id", "prolific_id")
clean_ids <- function(d) {
  names(d) <- trimws(gsub("^\ufeff", "", names(d)))   # removes a byte-order mark if the CSV has one
  low <- tolower(names(d))
  rename_first <- function(d, idx, new) { if (length(idx) && !(new %in% names(d))) names(d)[idx[1]] <- new; d }
  d <- rename_first(d, which(low == "pid"), "pid")
  d <- rename_first(d, which(low %in% c("response_id", "response id", "responseid")), "response_id")
  d <- rename_first(d, which(low %in% c("prolific_id", "prolific_pid", "prolificid", "url variable: prolific_pid")), "prolific_id")
  d |> mutate(across(any_of(ID_COLS), \(x) trimws(as.character(x))))
}
read_chr <- function(f) read_csv(f, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), na = c("", "NA")) |> clean_ids()

# Crosswalk: pid <-> prolific_id from the link file, then response_id matched on prolific_id from the 00 renamed file
ids <- if (file.exists(in_link)) read_chr(in_link) |> select(any_of(ID_COLS)) |> distinct() else tibble(pid = character())
for (col in ID_COLS) if (!col %in% names(ids)) ids[[col]] <- NA_character_
if (file.exists(in_ids)) {
  rn <- read_chr(in_ids) |> select(any_of(c("response_id", "prolific_id")))
  if (all(c("response_id", "prolific_id") %in% names(rn))) {
    rn <- rn |> filter(!is.na(prolific_id), !duplicated(prolific_id))
    ids$response_id <- coalesce(ids$response_id, rn$response_id[match(ids$prolific_id, rn$prolific_id)])
  }
}
ids <- ids |> select(all_of(ID_COLS))

# Fill whichever IDs a data frame is missing from the one(s) it has
add_ids <- function(d, label) {
  d <- clean_ids(d)
  for (col in ID_COLS) if (!col %in% names(d)) d[[col]] <- NA_character_
  for (key in ID_COLS) {
    lk <- ids[!is.na(ids[[key]]) & !duplicated(ids[[key]]), ]
    m <- match(d[[key]], lk[[key]])
    for (other in setdiff(ID_COLS, key)) d[[other]] <- coalesce(d[[other]], lk[[other]][m])
  }
  if (all(is.na(d$pid))) stop("Could not find or match a pid for ", label, ". It needs a pid, response_id or prolific_id column, ",
                              "and the link files must exist: ", basename(in_link), " and ", basename(in_ids), ".")
  ID_MATCH[[label]] <<- c(rows = nrow(d), with_pid = sum(!is.na(d$pid)))
  d |> filter(!is.na(pid)) |> relocate(all_of(ID_COLS))
}
ID_MATCH <- list()
d05   <- read_chr(in_05) |> add_ids("the survey file (05)")
codes <- read_chr(in_codes) |> add_ids("the codes file")
id_note <- paste0("ID matching: ", paste(vapply(names(ID_MATCH), \(k) paste0(k, " ", ID_MATCH[[k]]["with_pid"], " of ",
                  ID_MATCH[[k]]["rows"], " rows matched to a pid"), character(1)), collapse = "; "), ".")
if (!"coding_source_v2" %in% names(codes)) stop("The codes file has no v2 participant codes. Use 05_Q4_3_conversations_wide_deid_coded_v3.csv.")
if (!"coding_source_v3" %in% names(codes)) stop("The codes file has no v3 codes (question-type split, health areas). Use 05_Q4_3_conversations_wide_deid_coded_v3.csv.")

CODE_BIN <- c("convo_usable", "human_mentions_disease", "human_shares_personal", "human_asks_med", "human_multi_turn",
              "ai_recommends_med", "ai_refers_professional", "ai_urgent_care", "ai_followup_question", "ai_disclaimer",
              names(ASK_LABELS), names(ASK6_LABELS), names(TOPIC_LABELS), "human_pushback", "human_followup_adds_detail", "human_followup_new_question",
              "human_expresses_worry")
CODE_NUM <- c("n_human_turns", "ai_n_meds")
codes <- codes |> mutate(across(any_of(unique(c(CODE_BIN, CODE_NUM))), as.numeric))

# PANAS answers may export as numbers or as labels; both become 1-5
PANAS_LABELS <- c("very slightly or not at all" = 1, "a little" = 2, "moderately" = 3, "quite a bit" = 4, "extremely" = 5)
to_panas <- function(x) {
  t <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(t, "^[1-5](?![0-9])")))
  ifelse(!is.na(num), num, unname(PANAS_LABELS[t]))
}
# Items 1-5 were exported twice; use the main copy and fill any gaps from the *_dup copy
panas <- d05 |> select(pid)
for (wave in c("pre", "post")) for (item in c(PA_ITEMS, NA_ITEMS)) {
  main <- paste0("panas_", wave, "_", item); dup <- paste0(main, "_dup")
  v <- to_panas(d05[[main]])
  if (dup %in% names(d05)) v <- coalesce(v, to_panas(d05[[dup]]))
  panas[[main]] <- v
}
score <- function(wave, items) {
  m <- as.matrix(panas[paste0("panas_", wave, "_", items)])
  ifelse(rowSums(is.na(m)) == 0, rowSums(m), NA_real_)   # complete answers only
}
panas <- panas |> mutate(pa_pre = score("pre", PA_ITEMS), pa_post = score("post", PA_ITEMS),
                         na_pre = score("pre", NA_ITEMS), na_post = score("post", NA_ITEMS))

dat <- codes |>
  select(pid, any_of(unique(c(CODE_BIN, CODE_NUM))), any_of(c("human_first_intent", "human_about", "human_health_area", "coding_source_v2"))) |>
  left_join(panas |> select(pid, pa_pre, pa_post, na_pre, na_post), by = "pid") |>
  mutate(na_change = na_post - na_pre, pa_change = pa_post - pa_pre)

# The participant base for this deck: usable conversations with at least one participant message (v2 coded)
pp <- dat |> filter(!is.na(coding_source_v2))
multi <- pp |> filter(n_human_turns > 1)

CALMER_OF <- function(x) factor(case_when(x <= -CALMER_CUT ~ "Calmer", x >= CALMER_CUT ~ "More distressed",
                                          !is.na(x) ~ "About the same"), levels = c("Calmer", "About the same", "More distressed"))
```

```{r stats, include = FALSE}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
safe <- function(expr) tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) NULL)
fmt  <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d))
fmts <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", sprintf(paste0("%+.", d, "f"), x))
fmtp <- function(p, d = 3) ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", sub("^0", "", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = d))))
share <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; c(n = sum(x == 1), N = length(x), pct = 100 * mean(x == 1)) }
pct_lab <- function(s) paste0(round(s[["pct"]]), "% (", s[["n"]], " of ", s[["N"]], ")")

# ---- Shared chart theme: title states the result, subtitle gives the data details ----
theme_hx <- function() theme_minimal(base_size = 15) + theme(
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = INK, size = 18, margin = margin(b = 6)),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(color = MUTED, size = 12, margin = margin(b = 14)),
  plot.caption = element_text(color = MUTED, size = 10, hjust = 0),
  plot.title.position = "plot", plot.caption.position = "plot",
  axis.text = element_text(color = INK), axis.title = element_text(color = INK, size = 12),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_line(color = GRID),
  legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left", legend.title = element_blank(),
  plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), plot.margin = margin(20, 24, 16, 20))
save_fig <- function(p, name, w = 10, h = 8) { ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, bg = "white"); p }
wrap <- function(x, n = 70) paste(strwrap(x, n), collapse = "\n")

# Horizontal share bars used on several slides
share_bars <- function(df, title, subtitle, fills = DARK) {
  df <- df |> mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(label)))
  ggplot(df, aes(y = label)) +
    geom_col(aes(x = 100), fill = GRID, width = 0.62) +
    geom_col(aes(x = pct), fill = fills, width = 0.62) +
    geom_text(aes(x = pct, label = paste0(round(pct), "%")), hjust = -0.08, color = INK, size = 4.6, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 118), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(title = wrap(title), subtitle = wrap(subtitle, 110), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_hx() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
}

# ---- Collects every number shown in the deck, next to what R gets now ----
CHECK <- list()
check <- function(slide, measure, deck, r) CHECK[[length(CHECK) + 1]] <<- tibble(Slide = slide, Measure = measure, Deck = deck, R = r)
```

```{r hover-helpers, include = FALSE}
# ---- Interactive charts: hover over a bar, dot or square to see the numbers and example messages ----
# The examples are real conversation excerpts, so this report is for internal use only (keep it out of the public repo).
HOVER_EXAMPLES <- 3      # examples shown per bar or group
HOVER_CHARS    <- 180    # characters kept from each example
PLOT_W         <- 900    # chart width in pixels (fixed, so charts in hidden tabs draw at full size)
set.seed(2026)           # the same examples every time you knit; change the number to see others

TXT <- codes |> select(pid, matches("^(human|ai)_[0-9]+$"))
turns_of <- function(id, who) {
  r <- TXT[TXT$pid == id, , drop = FALSE]; if (!nrow(r)) return(character(0))
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", who, "_[0-9]+$"), names(r), value = TRUE)
  cols <- cols[order(as.integer(sub(".*_", "", cols)))]
  v <- as.character(unlist(r[1, cols], use.names = FALSE)); v[!is.na(v) & nzchar(trimws(v))]
}
clip <- function(x, n = HOVER_CHARS) { x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(x)); ifelse(nchar(x) > n, paste0(substr(x, 1, n - 3), "..."), x) }
wrap_html <- function(x, w = 60) vapply(x, function(s) paste(strwrap(htmltools::htmlEscape(s), w), collapse = "<br>"), character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)

# Words that point to the passage behind each code. Used only to pick which sentence or message to show.
PAT <- list(
  human_asks_cause          = "why|what (is|could|might|would)|caus|normal|serious|worr|concern|is (this|it|that) ",
  human_asks_what_cause     = "why|what (is|could|might|would)|caus|could (it|this) be",
  human_asks_serious        = "normal|serious|worr|concern|dangerous|should i be",
  human_asks_test_result    = "result|a1c|report|scan|x-?ray|mri|level|blood work|lab",
  human_asks_treatment      = "what (can|should) i (do|take|eat|use)|how (do|can|should) i|treat|reliev|help (with|my)|get rid|remed|manage",
  human_asks_condition_info = "what (is|are) |does .* (grow|spread|go away|last)|how long|tell me about|explain",
  human_asks_care           = "doctor|\\bdr\\b|see (a|someone|my)|urgent|\\ber\\b|emergency|specialist|appointment|clinic|test|surgery",
  human_asks_med            = "medic|\\bpills?\\b|dose|dosage|\\bmg\\b|ibuprofen|tylenol|advil|acetaminophen|antibiotic|prescri|zepbound|ozempic|semaglutide|tirzepatide",
  human_pushback            = "\\bno\\b|\\bbut\\b|actually|still|wrong|didn'?t|not what|that'?s not|are you sure",
  human_followup_new_question = "\\?",
  ai_refers_professional    = "doctor|physician|provider|healthcare professional|pharmacist|dermatologist|specialist|clinician|get (it |this )?(checked|evaluated|looked at)|appointment",
  ai_urgent_care            = "emergency|urgent care|\\ber\\b|911|immediate|right away|seek (medical )?(help|care|attention)",
  ai_followup_question      = "\\?\\s*$",
  ai_disclaimer             = "not a (doctor|substitute|medical professional)|not medical advice|informational purposes|cannot (diagnose|give medical)|not able to diagnose")
med_pattern <- function(id) {
  m <- codes$ai_meds_named[codes$pid == id]; m <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(ifelse(is.na(m[1]), "", m[1]), ";")))
  m <- m[nzchar(m)]; generic <- if (length(m)) paste(str_replace_all(m, "([.()+])", "\\\\\\1"), collapse = "|") else NULL
  paste(c(generic, PAT$human_asks_med), collapse = "|")
}

# A participant message: the first one (from message `from` on) that matches `pattern`, else the first one
pick_human <- function(id, pattern = NULL, from = 1) {
  m <- turns_of(id, "human"); if (length(m) < from) return(NA_character_); m <- m[from:length(m)]
  if (!is.null(pattern)) { k <- which(str_detect(tolower(m), pattern)); if (length(k)) return(m[k[1]]) }
  m[1]
}
# An AI sentence that matches `pattern` (the passage behind an AI code), else the AI's first sentence
pick_ai <- function(id, pattern = NULL) {
  s <- unlist(str_split(paste(turns_of(id, "ai"), collapse = " "), "(?<=[.!?])\\s+"))
  s <- s[nchar(trimws(s)) > 15]; if (!length(s)) return(NA_character_)
  if (!is.null(pattern)) { k <- which(str_detect(tolower(s), pattern)); if (length(k)) return(s[k[1]]) }
  s[1]
}
first_msg <- function(id) pick_human(id)
last_msg  <- function(id) { m <- turns_of(id, "human"); if (length(m) > 1) m[length(m)] else NA_character_ }
ask_msg   <- function(code) function(id) pick_human(id, PAT[[code]])
later_msg <- function(code = NULL) function(id) pick_human(id, if (is.null(code)) NULL else PAT[[code]], from = 2)
ai_msg    <- function(code = NULL) function(id) pick_ai(id, if (is.null(code)) NULL else
  if (code %in% c("ai_named_med", "ai_recommends_med")) med_pattern(id) else PAT[[code]])

# Up to HOVER_EXAMPLES people from `ids`; for each, one line per entry in `funs` (for example Participant and AI)
examples <- function(ids, funs, label = "Examples from the conversations") {
  ids <- unique(ids[!is.na(ids)]); if (!length(ids)) return("")
  ids <- if (length(ids) > HOVER_EXAMPLES) sample(ids, HOVER_EXAMPLES) else ids
  one <- function(i) {
    parts <- vapply(names(funs), function(nm) { t <- funs[[nm]](i)
      if (is.na(t) || !nzchar(t)) "" else paste0("<i>", nm, ":</i> ", wrap_html(clip(t))) }, character(1))
    parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]; if (!length(parts)) "" else paste0("<b>pid ", i, "</b><br>", paste(parts, collapse = "<br>"))
  }
  txt <- vapply(ids, one, character(1)); txt <- txt[nzchar(txt)]; if (!length(txt)) return("")
  paste0("<br><br><b>", label, "</b><br>", paste(txt, collapse = "<br><br>"))
}
ids_where <- function(d, cond) d$pid[!is.na(cond) & cond]
hover_share <- function(label, pct, n, N, ex) paste0("<b>", htmltools::htmlEscape(label), "</b><br>", round(pct), "% (", n, " of ", N, ")", ex)

# ---- plotly versions of the deck charts ----
ttl <- function(p) gsub("\n", " ", p$labels$title)
sub_of <- function(p) gsub("\n", " ", p$labels$subtitle %||% "")
pl_layout <- function(pl, p, ...) pl |> layout(
  title = list(text = paste0("<b>", paste(strwrap(htmltools::htmlEscape(ttl(p)), 85), collapse = "<br>"), "</b><br><span style='font-size:12px;color:", MUTED, "'>",
                             paste(strwrap(htmltools::htmlEscape(sub_of(p)), 125), collapse = "<br>"), "</span>"),
               x = 0, xanchor = "left", font = list(size = 16, color = INK)),
  margin = list(t = 120, l = 10, r = 30, b = 90), font = list(family = "Arial", color = INK),
  hoverlabel = list(align = "left", bgcolor = "white", bordercolor = GRID, font = list(color = INK, size = 12)),
  plot_bgcolor = "white", paper_bgcolor = "white", ...) |> config(displaylogo = FALSE)

# Horizontal share bars. df: label, pct, hover (rows top to bottom)
pl_bars <- function(df, p, xlab, colors = DARK) {
  df$y <- factor(df$label, levels = rev(df$label))
  plot_ly(df, y = ~y, x = ~pct, type = "bar", orientation = "h", marker = list(color = rep_len(colors, nrow(df))),
          text = ~paste0(round(pct), "%"), textposition = "outside", cliponaxis = FALSE, textfont = list(color = INK, size = 13),
          hovertext = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", height = 140 + 55 * nrow(df), width = PLOT_W) |>
    pl_layout(p, showlegend = FALSE, xaxis = list(title = xlab, range = c(0, 112), ticksuffix = "%", gridcolor = GRID, zeroline = FALSE),
              yaxis = list(title = "", automargin = TRUE))
}
# Stacked share bars. d: group (rows top to bottom), cat (factor, stack order), pct, hover; colors named by cat
pl_stack <- function(d, p, xlab, colors) {
  d$y <- factor(d$group, levels = rev(unique(d$group)))
  pl <- plot_ly(height = 400, width = PLOT_W)
  for (cc in levels(d$cat)) { s <- d[d$cat == cc, ]
    pl <- pl |> add_trace(data = s, y = ~y, x = ~pct, type = "bar", orientation = "h", name = cc, marker = list(color = colors[[cc]], line = list(color = "white", width = 2)),
                          text = ~ifelse(pct >= 5, paste0(round(pct), "%"), ""), textposition = "inside", insidetextanchor = "middle",
                          hovertext = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text") }
  pl |> pl_layout(p, barmode = "stack", xaxis = list(title = xlab, range = c(0, 100), ticksuffix = "%", gridcolor = GRID),
                  yaxis = list(title = "", automargin = TRUE), legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.45, traceorder = "normal"))
}
# One square per participant. w: x, y, group (factor), hover; colors in the order of levels(group)
pl_waffle <- function(w, p, colors, annotations = list()) {
  plot_ly(w, x = ~x, y = ~y, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", color = ~group, colors = colors,
          marker = list(symbol = "square", size = 26, line = list(color = "white", width = 1)), hovertext = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", height = 480, width = PLOT_W) |>
    pl_layout(p, xaxis = list(visible = FALSE), yaxis = list(visible = FALSE, scaleanchor = "x"), annotations = annotations,
              legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.05))
}
# Dumbbell: d has label (rows top to bottom), a, b, hover_a, hover_b
pl_dumbbell <- function(d, p, xlab, name_a, name_b, col_a = LIGHT, col_b = DARK, xrange = NULL) {
  d$y <- factor(d$label, levels = rev(d$label))
  plot_ly(d, height = 190 + 50 * nrow(d), width = PLOT_W) |>
    add_segments(x = ~a, xend = ~b, y = ~y, yend = ~y, line = list(color = BAR, width = 6), hoverinfo = "none", showlegend = FALSE) |>
    add_markers(x = ~a, y = ~y, name = name_a, marker = list(color = col_a, size = 14), hovertext = ~hover_a, hoverinfo = "text") |>
    add_markers(x = ~b, y = ~y, name = name_b, marker = list(color = col_b, size = 14), hovertext = ~hover_b, hoverinfo = "text") |>
    pl_layout(p, xaxis = list(title = xlab, gridcolor = GRID, zeroline = FALSE, range = xrange), yaxis = list(title = "", automargin = TRUE),
              legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.3))
}
```

```{js resize-in-tabs, echo = FALSE}
// Interactive charts in a tab are drawn while the tab is hidden; redraw them at full width when the tab opens
$(document).on("shown.bs.tab", function() { window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize")); });
```

This report recomputes every number in **Nov 2026 Pulse - AI and trust part 3a: what did people ask AI?** (and the matching web page, /part3a/) and draws a static version of each chart in the Healogix colors. Each chart is saved as a PNG (300 dpi) in `output/`r script_name`/figures/`. The **Check against deck** tab lists each number on the slides next to the value R gets now; any row marked "check" means the slide and the data disagree.

**Hover over any bar or square** to see the numbers and up to `r HOVER_EXAMPLES` example messages from the people in that group (the participant message or AI sentence that best shows the code). The examples are real conversation excerpts, so keep this report internal. The static deck version of each chart is saved as a PNG.

The base is the `r nrow(pp)` usable conversations with at least one participant message. The new participant codes (who the question was about, health area, kinds of questions, follow-up behavior, pushback, worry) are the v2 codes in the codebook (`coding_source_v2 = claude_llm_v2`). Each "asked" code looks across every participant message, so one person can count in more than one bar.

# Slides {.tabset}

## 4. Big numbers

```{r slide4}
s_cause <- share(pp$human_asks_cause)
s_med   <- share(pp$human_asks_med)

check("4", "Asked about their own health", "78%", pct_only(s_self))
check("4", "Asked what was causing a symptom", "52%", pct_only(s_cause))
check("4", "Asked about a specific medication", "12%", pct_only(s_med))

s3 <- tibble(label = c("Asked about their own health", "Asked what was causing a symptom", "Asked about a specific medication"),
             n = c(s_self[["n"]], s_cause[["n"]], s_med[["n"]]), N = c(s_self[["N"]], s_cause[["N"]], s_med[["N"]]),
             pct = c(s_self[["pct"]], s_cause[["pct"]], s_med[["pct"]]))

                            round(s_med[["pct"]]), "% asked about a medication"),
                 paste0("Coded from participant messages  |  n = ", nrow(pp), " usable conversations with at least one participant message"),

  hover_share(s3$label[2], s3$pct[2], s3$n[2], s3$N[2], examples(ids_where(pp, pp$human_asks_cause == 1), list(Participant = ask_msg("human_asks_cause")))),
  hover_share(s3$label[3], s3$pct[3], s3$n[3], s3$N[3], examples(ids_where(pp, pp$human_asks_med == 1), list(Participant = ask_msg("human_asks_med")))))
```

## 5. Who it was about

```{r slide5}
ab <- pp |> filter(!is.na(human_about)) |>
  mutate(who = factor(recode(human_about, self = "Themselves", other_person = "Someone else (partner, child)", general = "No one in particular (general questions)"),
                      levels = c("Themselves", "Someone else (partner, child)", "No one in particular (general questions)")))
by5 <- ab |> count(who, .drop = FALSE) |> mutate(N = sum(n), pct = 100 * n / N)
deck5 <- c("Themselves" = "78%", "Someone else (partner, child)" = "10%", "No one in particular (general questions)" = "12%")
for (w in names(deck5)) { r <- by5[by5$who == w, ]; check("5", paste("Question was about:", w), deck5[[w]], paste0(round(r$pct), "%")) }

COLS <- 10
w5 <- ab |> arrange(who) |> mutate(i = row_number() - 1, col = i %% COLS, row = -(i %/% COLS))
lab5 <- setNames(paste0(by5$who, ": ", round(by5$pct), "%"), by5$who)
p5 <- ggplot(w5, aes(x = col, y = row, fill = who)) +
  geom_tile(width = 0.86, height = 0.86) + coord_equal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(DARK, LIGHT, PALE), labels = lab5, drop = FALSE) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  labs(title = wrap(paste0("Most people asked about themselves; 1 in ", round(100 / by5$pct[2]), " asked for someone else")),
       subtitle = wrap(paste0("One square per participant  |  coded from participant messages  |  n = ", nrow(ab)), 110), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_hx() + theme(axis.text = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
invisible(save_fig(p5, "slide05_who-it-was-about", h = 6.5))
w5h <- w5 |> mutate(x = col, y = row, group = factor(lab5[as.character(who)], levels = unname(lab5[levels(who)])),
                    hover = paste0("<b>pid ", pid, "</b> | ", who, "<br><br><i>First message:</i> ", wrap_html(clip(vapply(pid, first_msg, character(1))))))
pl_waffle(w5h, p5, c(DARK, LIGHT, PALE))
```

```{r slide6}
         n = vapply(v, `[[`, numeric(1), "n"), N = vapply(v, `[[`, numeric(1), "N"), pct = vapply(v, `[[`, numeric(1), "pct")) |>
  select(-v)   # deck order
deck6 <- c(human_asks_what_cause = "46%", human_asks_treatment = "32%", human_asks_condition_info = "26%", human_asks_care = "16%",
           human_asks_serious = "12%", human_asks_med = "12%", human_asks_test_result = "6%")
for (cd in names(deck6)) { r <- s6q[s6q$code == cd, ]; check("6", paste("Asked:", ASK6_LABELS[[cd]]), deck6[[cd]], paste0(round(r$pct), "%")) }
n_kinds <- rowSums(pp[names(ASK6_LABELS)], na.rm = TRUE)
```

## 10. What they asked vs. what the AI said

```{r slide10}
# Every pairing of a question type with an AI response, with Fisher's exact test and a BH correction across all pairings.
AI_RESP <- c(ai_refers_professional = "AI referred to a professional", ai_urgent_care = "AI mentioned urgent care or the ER",
             ai_recommends_med = "AI recommended a medication", ai_followup_question = "AI asked a follow-up question")
pair_test <- function(a, r) {
  x <- pp[[a]]; y <- pp[[r]]; k <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y); x <- x[k]; y <- y[k]
  p <- if (sum(x == 1) >= MIN_GROUP_N && sum(x == 0) >= MIN_GROUP_N)
    safe(fisher.test(table(factor(x, 0:1), factor(y, 0:1)))$p.value) %||% NA_real_ else NA_real_
  tibble(ask = a, resp = r, n_yes = sum(x == 1), resp_yes = sum(x == 1 & y == 1), n_no = sum(x == 0), resp_no = sum(x == 0 & y == 1), p = p)
}
grid8 <- expand_grid(ask = names(ASK_LABELS), resp = names(AI_RESP))
xt <- bind_rows(Map(pair_test, grid8$ask, grid8$resp)) |>
  mutate(p_bh = { o <- rep(NA_real_, n()); ok <- !is.na(p); o[ok] <- p.adjust(p[ok], "BH"); o },
         `Question type` = ASK_LABELS[ask], `AI response` = AI_RESP[resp],
         `Asked` = paste0(round(100 * resp_yes / n_yes), "% (", resp_yes, " of ", n_yes, ")"),
         `Did not ask` = paste0(round(100 * resp_no / n_no), "% (", resp_no, " of ", n_no, ")"))

g <- function(a, r) xt[xt$ask == a & xt$resp == r, ]
c_ref <- g("human_asks_cause", "ai_refers_professional"); t_med <- g("human_asks_treatment", "ai_recommends_med")
t_ref <- g("human_asks_treatment", "ai_refers_professional")
check("10", "Referred: asked what was causing it", "100%", paste0(round(100 * c_ref$resp_yes / c_ref$n_yes), "%"))
check("10", "Referred: did not ask (headline: about 6 in 10)", "58%", paste0(round(100 * c_ref$resp_no / c_ref$n_no), "%"))
check("10", "Group sizes", "n = 26 / 24", paste0("n = ", c_ref$n_yes, " / ", c_ref$n_no))
check("10", "Fisher's exact p (BH across 20 pairings)", "< .001 (.004)", paste0(fmtp(c_ref$p), " (", fmtp(c_ref$p_bh), ")"))

d8 <- tibble(group = c(paste0("Asked what was causing it\n(n = ", c_ref$n_yes, ")"), paste0("Did not ask\n(n = ", c_ref$n_no, ")")),
             yes = c(c_ref$resp_yes, c_ref$resp_no), N = c(c_ref$n_yes, c_ref$n_no)) |>
  mutate(no = N - yes) |> pivot_longer(c(yes, no), names_to = "cat", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / N, cat = factor(cat, c("no", "yes"), c("AI did not refer", "AI referred to a professional")),
         group = factor(group, levels = rev(unique(group))))
p8 <- ggplot(d8, aes(x = pct, y = group, fill = cat)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(pct >= 8, paste0(round(pct), "%"), ""), color = cat == "AI referred to a professional"),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("AI referred to a professional" = DARK, "AI did not refer" = PALE), breaks = c("AI referred to a professional", "AI did not refer")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = INK), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = wrap("Asking AI for a cause always triggered a 'see a professional,' compared with about 6 in 10 times otherwise"),
       subtitle = wrap(paste0("Question type and referral both coded from the conversation text  |  Fisher's exact p ", ifelse(c_ref$p < .001, "", "= "), fmtp(c_ref$p),
                              " (BH-adjusted ", fmtp(c_ref$p_bh), " across all ", sum(!is.na(xt$p)), " tested pairings below)"), 110),
       x = "% of conversations", y = NULL) +
  theme_hx() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
invisible(save_fig(p8, "slide10_asked-vs-referral", h = 5.5))
grp8 <- list(asked = pp$human_asks_cause == 1, not = pp$human_asks_cause == 0)
d8h <- bind_rows(lapply(names(grp8), function(g) {
  inn <- !is.na(grp8[[g]]) & grp8[[g]]; N <- sum(inn)
  bind_rows(lapply(c(1, 0), function(v) { k <- inn & pp$ai_refers_professional == v; k[is.na(k)] <- FALSE
    cat <- if (v == 1) "AI referred to a professional" else "AI did not refer"
    grp <- if (g == "asked") paste0("Asked what was causing it (n = ", N, ")") else paste0("Did not ask (n = ", N, ")")
    funs <- if (v == 1) list(Participant = if (g == "asked") ask_msg("human_asks_cause") else first_msg, AI = ai_msg("ai_refers_professional"))
            else list(Participant = first_msg, AI = ai_msg())
    tibble(group = grp, cat = cat, n = sum(k), N = N, pct = 100 * sum(k) / N,
           hover = hover_share(paste0(grp, ": ", cat), 100 * sum(k) / N, sum(k), N, examples(pp$pid[k], funs))) }))
})) |> mutate(cat = factor(cat, c("AI referred to a professional", "AI did not refer")))
pl_stack(d8h, p8, "% of conversations", c("AI referred to a professional" = DARK, "AI did not refer" = PALE))
```

All pairings of question type and AI response. Descriptive; pairings with fewer than `r MIN_GROUP_N` people in a group are not tested.

```{r slide10-table}
kable(xt |> transmute(`Question type`, `AI response`, Asked, `Did not ask`, p = fmtp(p), `p (BH)` = fmtp(p_bh)), align = "llllrr")
```

## 11. How the AI answered

```{r slide11}
# Same 50 people as every other slide in Part 3A
s9 <- tibble(code = c("ai_refers_professional", "ai_followup_question", "ai_named_med", "ai_urgent_care", "ai_recommends_med", "ai_disclaimer"),
             label = c("Pointed them to a doctor or other professional", "Asked them a question back", "Named a specific medication",
                       "Mentioned urgent care or the ER", "Recommended they take a medication", "Included a disclaimer (not medical advice)")) |>
  mutate(v = lapply(code, function(cd) share(if (cd == "ai_named_med") as.numeric(pp$ai_n_meds > 0) else pp[[cd]])),
         n = vapply(v, `[[`, numeric(1), "n"), N = vapply(v, `[[`, numeric(1), "N"), pct = vapply(v, `[[`, numeric(1), "pct")) |> select(-v)
deck9 <- c(ai_refers_professional = "80%", ai_followup_question = "62%", ai_named_med = "40%", ai_urgent_care = "36%",
           ai_recommends_med = "22%", ai_disclaimer = "10%")
for (cd in names(deck9)) { r <- s9[s9$code == cd, ]; check("11", paste("AI:", r$label), deck9[[cd]], paste0(round(r$pct), "%")) }
no_care <- pp |> filter(human_asks_care == 0)
named   <- pp |> filter(ai_n_meds > 0)
check("11", "Footer: referred among those who did not ask about care", "79%", paste0(round(100 * mean(no_care$ai_refers_professional == 1, na.rm = TRUE)), "%"))
check("11", "Footer: chats naming a drug where the person had not asked about one", "70%", paste0(round(100 * mean(named$human_asks_med == 0, na.rm = TRUE)), "%"))

p9 <- share_bars(s9 |> select(label, n, N, pct), "The AI pointed 4 in 5 people to a professional, but rarely added a disclaimer",
                 paste0("What the AI did in its replies  |  coded from the AI's text  |  n = ", nrow(pp), "  |  one conversation can count in several bars"),
                 fills = c(DARK, LIGHT, DARK, LIGHT, LIGHT, DARK)) + labs(x = "% of conversations")
invisible(save_fig(p9, "slide11_how-the-ai-answered", h = 6.5))
s9$hover <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(s9)), function(i) {
  cd <- s9$code[i]; inn <- if (cd == "ai_named_med") pp$ai_n_meds > 0 else pp[[cd]] == 1
  hover_share(s9$label[i], s9$pct[i], s9$n[i], s9$N[i], examples(ids_where(pp, inn), list(Participant = first_msg, AI = ai_msg(cd)))) }, character(1))
pl_bars(s9, p9, "% of conversations", c(DARK, LIGHT, DARK, LIGHT, LIGHT, DARK))
```

## 12. Medications asked about vs. recommended

```{r slide12}
# One row per conversation that involved a medication question or recommendation (deck slide 12)
if (!file.exists(in_meds)) {
  cat("10_Q4_3_med_asked_vs_recommended.csv not found, so this slide is not checked.")
} else {
  meds <- read_chr(in_meds) |> add_ids("the medication file") |> select(pid, human_meds_asked, ai_recommended_meds, med_symptom, med_group) |>
    inner_join(pp |> select(pid, human_asks_med, ai_recommends_med), by = "pid")
  # The drug lists must agree with the yes/no codes they came from
  bad <- meds |> filter((human_asks_med == 1) != !is.na(human_meds_asked) | (ai_recommends_med == 1) != !is.na(ai_recommended_meds))
  if (nrow(bad)) cat("Warning:", nrow(bad), "rows where the drug lists and the yes/no codes disagree (pids:", paste(bad$pid, collapse = ", "), ")\n\n")
  gc <- table(factor(meds$med_group, levels = c("asked_and_recommended", "asked_only", "recommended_unasked", "neither")))
  check("12", "Asked, and got a recommendation", "3 people", as.character(gc[["asked_and_recommended"]]))
  check("12", "Asked, no recommendation", "3 people", as.character(gc[["asked_only"]]))
  check("12", "Recommended without being asked", "8 people", as.character(gc[["recommended_unasked"]]))
  check("12", "Conversations shown", "14 of 50", paste(sum(gc[1:3]), "of", nrow(meds)))
  ORDER <- c(asked_and_recommended = "Asked, and got a recommendation", asked_only = "Asked, no recommendation", recommended_unasked = "Recommended without being asked")
  tab <- meds |> filter(med_group != "neither") |>
    mutate(Group = factor(ORDER[med_group], levels = ORDER), `What they asked about (or described)` = coalesce(human_meds_asked, paste0("(symptom) ", med_symptom)),
           `What the AI recommended` = coalesce(ai_recommended_meds, "explained only")) |>
    arrange(Group, as.numeric(pid)) |> select(Group, pid, `What they asked about (or described)`, `What the AI recommended`)
  kable(tab)
}
```

## 13. Medications by type of drug (alternative to slide 12)

```{r slide13}
# Same data as slide 12, counted by drug class: % of the 50 participants who asked about each class, and who were recommended one
if (exists("meds")) {
  has <- function(x, p) !is.na(x) & str_detect(tolower(x), p)
  s13 <- DRUG_CLASSES |> mutate(asked = vapply(pattern, function(p) sum(has(meds$human_meds_asked, p)), integer(1)),
                                recommended = vapply(pattern, function(p) sum(has(meds$ai_recommended_meds, p)), integer(1)),
                                pa = 100 * asked / nrow(pp), pr = 100 * recommended / nrow(pp))
  deck13 <- list("OTC pain relievers" = c("0%", "14%"), "Antibiotics" = c("4%", "0%"), "Osteoporosis drugs" = c("2%", "2%"),
                 "Antifungal creams" = c("2%", "2%"), "Weight-loss drug" = c("2%", "0%"), "ADHD drug" = c("2%", "0%"),
                 "Antihistamines" = c("0%", "2%"), "Gas relief" = c("0%", "2%"))
  for (k in names(deck13)) { r <- s13[s13$class == k, ]
    check("13", paste("Asked about:", k), deck13[[k]][1], paste0(round(r$pa), "%"))
    check("13", paste("AI recommended:", k), deck13[[k]][2], paste0(round(r$pr), "%")) }
  check("13", "Footer: named a drug in their own messages", "12%", paste0(round(100 * mean(pp$human_asks_med == 1, na.rm = TRUE)), "%"))
  check("13", "Footer: AI recommended a specific drug", "22%", paste0(round(100 * mean(pp$ai_recommends_med == 1, na.rm = TRUE)), "%"))
  d13 <- s13 |> select(class, pa, pr) |> pivot_longer(c(pa, pr), names_to = "who", values_to = "pct") |>
    mutate(who = factor(who, c("pa", "pr"), c("Person asked about it", "AI recommended it")), class = factor(class, rev(DRUG_CLASSES$class)),
           x = ifelse(who == "Person asked about it", -pct, pct))
  p13 <- ggplot(d13, aes(x = x, y = class, fill = who)) + geom_col(width = 0.62) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = BAR) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(pct), "%"), hjust = ifelse(who == "Person asked about it", 1.15, -0.15),
                  color = pct > 0), size = 4.4, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = INK, `FALSE` = "#9aa3ad"), guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Person asked about it" = LIGHT, "AI recommended it" = DARK)) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-18, 18), breaks = seq(-15, 15, 5), labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "%")) +
    labs(title = wrap("People asked about prescriptions; the AI recommended over-the-counter relief"),
         subtitle = wrap(paste0("Asked about vs. recommended, by type of drug  |  % of participants (n = ", nrow(pp), ")"), 110), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_hx() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
  invisible(save_fig(p13, "slide13_meds-by-drug-type", h = 6.5))
  p13
} else cat("10_Q4_3_med_asked_vs_recommended.csv not found, so this slide is not checked.")
```

## New codes and feelings

Exploratory: how feelings changed for each new participant code. These are **not on the slides**. Tests follow 07 (Mann-Whitney on change scores, Fisher's exact on felt calmer), with a BH correction across the new codes within each outcome. Codes with fewer than `r MIN_GROUP_N` people in a group are shown but not tested. Follow-up codes use only multi-message chats.

```{r new-codes}
NEW_SEG <- list(
  "Asked about themselves"          = factor(ifelse(dat$human_about == "self", "About themselves", ifelse(is.na(dat$human_about), NA, "Someone else or general")),
                                             levels = c("About themselves", "Someone else or general")),
  "Asked what was causing it, or if it was serious (combined)" = dat$human_asks_cause,
  "Asked what was causing it"       = dat$human_asks_what_cause,
  "Asked if it was normal or serious" = dat$human_asks_serious,
  "Asked how to treat or manage it" = dat$human_asks_treatment,
  "Asked general facts"             = dat$human_asks_condition_info,
  "Asked whether or where to get care" = dat$human_asks_care,
  "Expressed worry in their own words" = dat$human_expresses_worry,
  "Added detail later (multi-message)" = dat$human_followup_adds_detail,
  "Asked a new question later (multi-message)" = dat$human_followup_new_question,
  "Pushed back (multi-message)"     = dat$human_pushback)
NEW_SEG <- lapply(NEW_SEG, function(x) if (is.factor(x)) x else factor(ifelse(x == 1, "Yes", ifelse(x == 0, "No", NA)), levels = c("Yes", "No")))

one <- function(name, grp) {
  d <- tibble(g = grp, na = dat$na_change, pa = dat$pa_change) |> filter(!is.na(g)) |> mutate(g = droplevels(g))
  lv <- levels(d$g); ok <- length(lv) == 2
  n_na <- table(d$g[!is.na(d$na)]); n_pa <- table(d$g[!is.na(d$pa)])
  t_ok <- function(n) ok && length(n) == 2 && all(n >= MIN_GROUP_N)
  calm <- d |> filter(!is.na(na)) |> mutate(c = na <= -CALMER_CUT)
  tibble(Segment = name, Groups = paste(lv, collapse = " / "),
         n = paste(as.integer(n_na[lv]), collapse = " / "),
         `Negative affect change` = paste(fmts(tapply(d$na, d$g, mean, na.rm = TRUE)[lv]), collapse = " / "),
         p_na = if (t_ok(n_na)) safe(wilcox.test(na ~ g, data = d, exact = FALSE)$p.value) %||% NA_real_ else NA_real_,
         `Positive affect change` = paste(fmts(tapply(d$pa, d$g, mean, na.rm = TRUE)[lv]), collapse = " / "),
         p_pa = if (t_ok(n_pa)) safe(wilcox.test(pa ~ g, data = d, exact = FALSE)$p.value) %||% NA_real_ else NA_real_,
         `Felt calmer` = paste(paste0(round(100 * tapply(calm$c, calm$g, mean)[lv]), "%"), collapse = " / "),
         p_calm = if (t_ok(n_na)) safe(fisher.test(table(calm$g, factor(calm$c, c(FALSE, TRUE))))$p.value) %||% NA_real_ else NA_real_)
}
nt <- bind_rows(Map(one, names(NEW_SEG), NEW_SEG))
bhv <- function(p) { o <- rep(NA_real_, length(p)); k <- !is.na(p); o[k] <- p.adjust(p[k], "BH"); o }
nt <- nt |> mutate(`p NA (BH)` = paste0(fmtp(p_na), " (", fmtp(bhv(p_na)), ")"),
                   `p PA (BH)` = paste0(fmtp(p_pa), " (", fmtp(bhv(p_pa)), ")"),
                   `p calmer (BH)` = paste0(fmtp(p_calm), " (", fmtp(bhv(p_calm)), ")")) |>
  select(Segment, Groups, n, `Negative affect change`, `p NA (BH)`, `Positive affect change`, `p PA (BH)`, `Felt calmer`, `p calmer (BH)`)
kable(nt, align = "llrlrlrlr")

# Before-and-after chart for each new code (negative affect)
pp_na <- bind_rows(Map(function(name, grp) {
  tibble(seg = name, g = grp, pre = dat$na_pre, post = dat$na_post) |> filter(!is.na(g), !is.na(pre), !is.na(post)) |>
    group_by(seg, g) |> summarise(n = n(), pre = mean(pre), post = mean(post), .groups = "drop")
}, names(NEW_SEG), NEW_SEG)) |> mutate(label = paste0(seg, ": ", g, " (n = ", n, ")"))
pp_na$label <- factor(pp_na$label, levels = rev(pp_na$label))
long_n <- pp_na |> pivot_longer(c(pre, post), names_to = "when", values_to = "score") |>
  mutate(when = factor(when, c("pre", "post"), c("Before the chat", "After the chat")))
pn <- ggplot(pp_na, aes(y = label)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = pre, xend = post, yend = label), color = BAR, linewidth = 2, lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(data = long_n, aes(x = score, color = when), size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Before the chat" = LIGHT, "After the chat" = DARK)) +
  labs(title = "Negative affect before and after, by new participant code",
       subtitle = "PANAS negative affect (10 to 50)  |  exploratory, not on the slides", x = "Negative affect score", y = NULL) +
  theme_hx() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))
save_fig(pn, "extra_new-codes-negative-affect", h = 9)
openxlsx::write.xlsx(list(new_codes_feelings = nt, asked_vs_ai = xt |> select(`Question type`, `AI response`, Asked, `Did not ask`, p, p_bh)),
                     file.path(out_dir, "new-codes-tests.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

## Check against deck

```{r check}
check_tbl <- bind_rows(CHECK) |>
  mutate(Match = ifelse(Deck == "(not on slide)", "info",
                        ifelse(gsub("[^0-9.+-]", "", gsub("0\\.", ".", Deck)) == gsub("[^0-9.+-]", "", gsub("0\\.", ".", R)), "yes", "check"))) |>
  select(Slide, Measure, Deck, R, Match)
openxlsx::write.xlsx(list(deck_check = check_tbl), file.path(out_dir, "deck-number-check.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
n_off <- sum(check_tbl$Match == "check")
cat(if (n_off == 0) "Every number on the slides matches the data.\n\n" else
  paste0("**", n_off, " number(s) differ from the slides.** These rows are marked \"check\". Update the slide, or look at what changed in the data.\n\n"))
cat(id_note, "\n\n")
kable(check_tbl, align = "llllc")
```

The "Match" column compares the digits only, so formatting differences (for example ".02" vs. "0.02") do not count as a mismatch. This table is also saved as `deck-number-check.xlsx` in the output folder, and the exploratory tests are in `new-codes-tests.xlsx`.
